page_title: HTTPie – API testing client that flows with you

sources.entry: HTTPie - HTTPie is making APIs simple and intuitive for those building the tools of our time. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: HTTPie
summary.one_liner: HTTPie is an API testing client, offered as a terminal tool and as a graphical web and desktop app in public beta.
use_cases: sending HTTP requests to web services
summary.what_it_does: HTTPie is a tool for testing and working with HTTP servers, RESTful APIs, and web services. The page describes a Terminal version (CLI) and a graphical interface for web and desktop, version 2025.2.0, which is in public beta. The page mentions recent changelog features including export/import, path parameters, and copy as command. It is listed in awesome-mac under API Development and Analysis, marked as freeware.
notable: Terminal (CLI) and graphical web and desktop versions share the same user-friendly approach
Recent changelog adds export/import, path parameters, and copy as command
Desktop/web app is in public beta
caveats: Web and desktop app is in public beta
Pricing not stated on the page
